confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Danish price levels; no live menus, listings, or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable, while hostel and hotel anchors are least certain because July peak-season rates vary widely. Cocktail and wine were anchored to the beer estimate using typical local price ratios because direct knowledge is weaker. Local-currency estimates were converted to USD at an approximate rate rather than a live quote, so USD values carry extra FX uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Danish and wider Nordic price levels, with Aarhus estimated somewhat below Copenhagen levels and accommodation reflecting July tourism demand in a mid-sized city.
